rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for being nearly at a state or for nearly all or no people or things.

example.jyutping: ngo5 caa1 m4 do1 sik6 saai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this especially for emphatic nearly-all, nearly-none, or nearly-but-not-quite statements.

example.jyutping: gei1 fu4 mou5 jan4 gei3 dak1 ni1 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this for a near miss, especially when an event almost happened or an unwanted result was narrowly avoided.

example.english: I almost fell down the stairs.
example.jyutping: ngo5 caa1 di1 dit3 lok6 lau4 tai1

rows.note: Use this when something is almost about to happen or a time or stage is imminent.

example.jyutping: bou6 hei3 zau6 faai3 hoi1 coeng4 laa3
